Radbon Electronics has earned IPC/WHMA‑A‑620 Quality Management Level (QML) validation, confirming that it meets rigorous industry safety and quality standards for hazardous material handling. The certification also places the company on the IPC Global Qualified Manufacturers List, marking it as a verified supplier within the electronics manufacturing sector. This achievement underscores Radbon’s commitment to high‑quality production practices and adherence to global benchmarks.
